customEventFeeds.title: Custom event feeds
customEventFeeds.description: Bring in data from outside: a heart-rate sensor, a REST ticker, a companion app. Each feed makes a custom event that starts pipelines, fills variables and feeds overlays.
customEventFeeds.empty: No feeds yet. Make one to bring in outside data.
customEventFeeds.loadFailed: The feeds could not be loaded.
customEventFeeds.enabledHelp: A feed that is off takes in nothing.
customEventFeeds.fieldErrors: These fields failed on the last data: {fields}
customEventFeeds.name: Event name
customEventFeeds.nameHelp: Pipelines use custom.{name} as the trigger and {'{{'}custom.{name}.field{'}}'} as the value.
customEventFeeds.intervalHelp: The bot may raise this number to stay inside the limit of your plan.
customEventFeeds.secretKept: Saved. Type a new one to replace it.

secretHelp.poll: Sent to the address as a bearer token. Leave empty if the address needs none.
secretHelp.socket: Sent to the socket as a bearer token. Leave empty if the socket needs none.
secretHelp.push: The source signs what it posts with this secret. A push feed needs one.

kind.title: How data arrives
kind.pollHelp: The bot reads the address on a timer. The address must be on your allowed list.
kind.socketHelp: The bot keeps a connection open and takes in every message.
kind.pushHelp: The source posts to a link the bot gives you after you save.

fields.title: Fields
fields.help: A field is a name and the path of its value in the data, for example bpm and $.data.heartRate.
fields.name: Field name

create.title: New feed
create.description: Choose how the data arrives and which fields you want from it.

test.title: Test {name}
test.description: Send a sample to see the custom event work, without waiting for the source.
test.truncated: The list is cut off. The answer has more paths.
test.sent: Sent. custom.{name} fired with your sample.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: The feed stops and its data stops coming in.
